fields.Name: T325 - Advanced Options Progressive Disclosure Sections
fields.Description: Exercises the ShowAdvanced progressive-disclosure block gating the Details + Notifications sections (activation window, timezone, JSON payload, notify condition, channel switches) — a bespoke collapsible editor layout, not a generated form section.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Routines app, click 'New Routine' and locate the 'Advanced options' collapsible toggle (it lists 'description · monitoring · timezone · window · payload · skills · notifications'). It is collapsed by default. Click it to expand and confirm the advanced controls appear: a Description box, a Timezone combobox, an 'Active from' / 'Active until' datetime pair (the activation window), a Starting payload JSON code editor, and a Notifications section with a 'Notify me' dropdown plus In-app / Email switches. Click the toggle again to collapse it. Success is seeing the section expand to reveal these grouped advanced fields and collapse back.

judgeValidationCriteria: The advanced section is collapsed initially and expands when the toggle is clicked

Expanded content includes a Timezone control, an activation-window datetime pair (Active from / Active until), a starting-payload editor, and a Notifications area with a notify-condition dropdown and In-app/Email switches
The section collapses again when toggled off
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
